\--// ============== LIMPEZA AO FECHAR (nada fica rodando depois que o hub fecha) ==============
local Conns, Cleanup = {}, {}
local function track(c) Conns\[#Conns + 1] = c return c end

\-- RS / UIS / Players passam a registrar cada :Connect para desligar tudo ao fechar
local function proxy(svc)
local cache = {}
return setmetatable({}, {__index = function(_, k)
	local v = svc[k]
	if typeof(v) == "RBXScriptSignal" then
		if not cache[k] then
			cache[k] = {
				Connect = function(_, f) return track(v:Connect(f)) end,
				Wait = function() return v:Wait() end,
			}
		end
		return cache[k]
	elseif type(v) == "function" then
		return function(_, ...) return v(svc, ...) end
	end
	return v
end})
end
RS, UIS, Players = proxy(RS), proxy(UIS), proxy(Players)

local shuttingDown = false
local function Shutdown()
if shuttingDown then return end
shuttingDown = true
for i = #Cleanup, 1, -1 do pcall(Cleanup\[i]) end   -- desliga funcoes e devolve o personagem ao normal
for \_, c in ipairs(Conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
Conns = {}
pcall(function() if getgenv and getgenv().GUBBYHUB_SHUTDOWN == Shutdown then getgenv().GUBBYHUB_SHUTDOWN = nil end end)
end
pcall(function()   -- se ja existe um hub aberto (executou de novo), fecha o antigo direito
if getgenv then
if getgenv().GUBBYHUB_SHUTDOWN then pcall(getgenv().GUBBYHUB_SHUTDOWN) end
getgenv().GUBBYHUB_SHUTDOWN = Shutdown
end
end)

pcall(function() if setfpscap then setfpscap(120) end end)

\--// ============== HELPERS ==============
local function new(class, props)
local o = Instance.new(class)
for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do if k \~= "Parent" then o\[k] = v end end
if props and props.Parent then o.Parent = props.Parent end
return o
end

local function tween(obj, t, props, style, dir)
local tw = TS:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t or 0.2, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
tw:Play()
return tw
end

local function corner(p, r) return new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 8), Parent = p}) end

local function stroke(p, c, t, tr)
return new("UIStroke", {Color = c or C.accent, Thickness = t or 1, Transparency = tr or 0,
	ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = p})
end

local function lbl(parent, props)
props.BackgroundTransparency = 1
props.Font = props.Font or GM
props.TextSize = props.TextSize or 12
props.TextColor3 = props.TextColor3 or C.text
props.TextXAlignment = props.TextXAlignment or LEFT
props.Parent = parent
return new("TextLabel", props)
end

\--// miniatura do item (funciona com ID de Decal e carrega na hora, sem tentativa/espera)
local function thumb(id) return "rbxthumb://type=Asset\&id=" .. id .. "\&w=420\&h=420" end

\--// ============== PRE-CARREGAMENTO (imagens carregam antes do hub abrir) ==============
\--// ---------- DETECTA O JOGO (Steal an Egg) ----------
local EGG_GAME_ID = "107778070777162"   -- ID do Steal an Egg (confere PlaceId e GameId)
local GameInfo = {egg = (tostring(game.PlaceId) == EGG_GAME_ID or tostring(game.GameId) == EGG_GAME_ID), name = nil}

local Preload = {done = false, total = 0, count = 0}
do
local ids = {IMG_BTN, IMG_GUBBY, IMG_KEY, IMG_HUB, IMG_HOME_BG}
for \_, id in ipairs({"102434660897566", "107545868372538", "71099820385271", "128945632487494", "131076537252100",
	"125369431368374", "77564059021754", "125219996525813", "128083027945895", "116209529850133",
	"91431507492679", "118962677451672", "117553034112414",
	"105483263788845", "135922264078307", "137621952072140"}) do
ids\[#ids + 1] = thumb(id)
end
ids\[#ids + 1] = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot\&id=" .. tostring(LP.UserId) .. "\&w=150\&h=150"
ids\[#ids + 1] = "rbxthumb://type=GameIcon\&id=" .. tostring(game.GameId) .. "\&w=150\&h=150"
Preload.total = #ids
task.spawn(function()
\-- confere tambem pelo nome do jogo (caso o ID mude): "Steal an Egg" (sem "Jump")
pcall(function()
local info = game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId)
if info and info.Name then
GameInfo.name = info.Name
local n = info.Name:lower()
if n:find("steal an egg", 1, true) and not n:find("jump", 1, true) then GameInfo.egg = true end
end
end)
pcall(function()
game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(ids, function() Preload.count = Preload.count + 1 end)
end)
Preload.done = true
end)
end

local function getGuiParent()
local ok, res = pcall(function()
if gethui then return gethui() end
return CoreGui
end)
if ok and res then return res end
return LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local function executeScript(code)
local loader = loadstring or load
if not loader then return false, "no loader" end
local fn, pe = loader(code)
if not fn then return false, tostring(pe) end
local ok, re = pcall(fn)
if not ok then return false, tostring(re) end
return true
end

local function cleanOld()
local parents = {CoreGui, LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")}
pcall(function() if gethui then table.insert(parents, gethui()) end end)
for \_, parent in ipairs(parents) do
pcall(function()
for \_, obj in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
if obj:IsA("ScreenGui") and (obj.Name:match("^GUBBYHUB") or obj.Name:match("^Combo")) then
obj:Destroy()
end
end
end)
end
end
cleanOld()

return ok
end

\--// ============== SHA-256 (puro Lua / bit32) ==============
local SHA_K = {
	0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5,
	0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
	0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3,
	0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
	0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc,
	0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
	0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7,
	0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
	0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13,
	0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
	0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3,
	0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
	0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5,
	0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
	0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208,
	0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2
}
local function sha256(msg)
local band, bxor, bnot, rshift, rrotate = bit32.band, bit32.bxor, bit32.bnot, bit32.rshift, bit32.rrotate
local len = #msg
local bits = len \* 8
local hi, lo = math.floor(bits / 4294967296), bits % 4294967296
msg = msg .. "\128" .. string.rep("\0", (55 - len) % 64)
.. string.char(rshift(hi, 24) % 256, rshift(hi, 16) % 256, rshift(hi, 8) % 256, hi % 256,
rshift(lo, 24) % 256, rshift(lo, 16) % 256, rshift(lo, 8) % 256, lo % 256)
local H = {0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19}
for i = 1, #msg, 64 do
local w = {}
for j = 0, 15 do
local b1, b2, b3, b4 = string.byte(msg, i + j _4, i + j_ 4 + 3)
w\[j] = ((b1 _256 + b2)_ 256 + b3) \* 256 + b4
end
for j = 16, 63 do
local s0 = bxor(rrotate(w\[j - 15], 7), rrotate(w\[j - 15], 18), rshift(w\[j - 15], 3))
local s1 = bxor(rrotate(w\[j - 2], 17), rrotate(w\[j - 2], 19), rshift(w\[j - 2], 10))
w\[j] = (w\[j - 16] + s0 + w\[j - 7] + s1) % 4294967296
end
local a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h = H\[1], H\[2], H\[3], H\[4], H\[5], H\[6], H\[7], H\[8]
for j = 0, 63 do
local S1 = bxor(rrotate(e, 6), rrotate(e, 11), rrotate(e, 25))
local ch = bxor(band(e, f), band(bnot(e), g))
local t1 = (h + S1 + ch + SHA_K\[j + 1] + w\[j]) % 4294967296
local S0 = bxor(rrotate(a, 2), rrotate(a, 13), rrotate(a, 22))
local maj = bxor(band(a, b), band(a, c), band(b, c))
local t2 = (S0 + maj) % 4294967296
h = g g = f f = e
e = (d + t1) % 4294967296
d = c c = b b = a
a = (t1 + t2) % 4294967296
end
H\[1] = (H\[1] + a) % 4294967296 H\[2] = (H\[2] + b) % 4294967296
H\[3] = (H\[3] + c) % 4294967296 H\[4] = (H\[4] + d) % 4294967296
H\[5] = (H\[5] + e) % 4294967296 H\[6] = (H\[6] + f) % 4294967296
H\[7] = (H\[7] + g) % 4294967296 H\[8] = (H\[8] + h) % 4294967296
end
local out = {}
for i = 1, 8 do
local n = H\[i]
out\[i] = string.format("%02x%02x%02x%02x", rshift(n, 24), band(rshift(n, 16), 255), band(rshift(n, 8), 255), band(n, 255))
end
return table.concat(out)
end

\--// ============== ARQUIVOS (keys / configs) ==============
local function ensureFolder()
if writefile and isfolder and makefolder then
if not isfolder(CONFIG_FOLDER) then pcall(makefolder, CONFIG_FOLDER) end
end
end

local function normalizeKey(s)
s = tostring(s or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
return s:upper()
end

local function loadUsedKeys()
if not (readfile and isfile) then return {} end
if not isfile(USED_KEYS_FILE) then return {} end
local ok, content = pcall(readfile, USED_KEYS_FILE)
if not ok then return {} end
local ok2, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(content) end)
if not ok2 or type(data) \~= "table" then return {} end
return data
end

local function saveUsedKeys(tbl)
if not writefile then return false end
ensureFolder()
local ok, enc = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(tbl) end)
if not ok then return false end
return pcall(writefile, USED_KEYS_FILE, enc)
end

local function registerKeyUse(key)
local used = loadUsedKeys()
if used\[key] then return end
used\[key] = {UserId = LP.UserId, Name = LP.Name, DisplayName = LP.DisplayName, Key = key, Time = os.time()}
saveUsedKeys(used)
end

\--// ============== VALIDACAO DE KEY (hash SHA-256 + bloqueio) ==============
\-- (opcional) link RAW com hashes de keys REVOGADAS, um por linha. Vazio = desligado.
local KEY_REVOKE_URL = ""
local MAX_TRIES, LOCK_SECONDS = 5, 60
local LOCK_FILE = CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/.key_lock"
local KEY_PATTERN = "^GUBBYHUB%-%w%w%w%w%-%w%w%w%w%-%w%w%w%w%-%w%w%w%w$"

\-- URL do servidor de keys (Google Apps Script, veja GUBBYHUB_KEY_SERVER_LEIA-ME.md).
\-- Preenchida: cada key fica presa a UMA conta Roblox (quem usar primeiro), em qualquer aparelho.
\-- Vazia: a key fica presa a conta so neste aparelho.
local KEY_SERVER_URL = ""

local function hashKey(k) return sha256(KEY_SALT .. k) end

local revokedSet
local function getRevoked()
if revokedSet then return revokedSet end
revokedSet = {}
if KEY_REVOKE_URL \~= "" then
pcall(function()
local body = game:HttpGet(KEY_REVOKE_URL)
for line in tostring(body):gmatch("\[^\r\n]+") do
local clean = line:gsub("%s+", "")
revokedSet\[clean:lower()] = true
end
end)
end
return revokedSet
end

\-- retorna ok, motivo ("invalid" | "revoked" | "expired")
local function checkKeyHash(h)
local exp = KEY_HASHES\[h]
if exp == nil then return false, "invalid" end
if getRevoked()\[h] then return false, "revoked" end
if exp \~= 0 and os.time() >= exp then return false, "expired" end
return true
end

\--// bloqueio por tentativas erradas (persistente)
local lockFails, lockUntil = 0, 0
do
if isfile and readfile then
local ok, ex = pcall(isfile, LOCK_FILE)
if ok and ex then
local ok2, c = pcall(readfile, LOCK_FILE)
if ok2 then
local f, u = tostring(c):match("^(%d+)|(%d+)$")
lockFails, lockUntil = tonumber(f) or 0, tonumber(u) or 0
end
end
end
end
local function writeLock()
if not writefile then return end
ensureFolder()
pcall(writefile, LOCK_FILE, lockFails .. "|" .. lockUntil)
end
local function lockLeft() return math.max(0, lockUntil - os.time()) end
local function registerFail()
lockFails = lockFails + 1
if lockFails >= MAX_TRIES then
lockUntil = os.time() + LOCK_SECONDS
lockFails = 0
end
writeLock()
return MAX_TRIES - lockFails
end
local function clearFails() lockFails, lockUntil = 0, 0 writeLock() end

\--// o WindUI salva a key em <Folder>/<hwid>.key
local KEYGATE_FOLDER = "GUBBYHUB"
local function keyFilePath()
local id
pcall(function() if gethwid then id = gethwid() end end)
return KEYGATE_FOLDER .. "/" .. tostring(id or LP.UserId) .. ".key"
end

local function clearKeySaved() if delfile then pcall(delfile, keyFilePath()) end end

\--// ---------- key presa a UMA conta ----------
local KeyBind = {}
local OWNERS_FILE = CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/.key_owners.json"

\-- modo local (sem servidor): hash da key -> UserId do dono, guardado neste aparelho
local function loadOwners()
if not (isfile and readfile) then return {} end
local ok, ex = pcall(isfile, OWNERS_FILE)
if not ok or not ex then return {} end
local ok2, c = pcall(readfile, OWNERS_FILE)
if not ok2 then return {} end
local ok3, d = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(c) end)
return (ok3 and type(d) == "table") and d or {}
end
local function saveOwners(t)
if not writefile then return end
ensureFolder()
pcall(function() writefile(OWNERS_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(t)) end)
end

\-- fala com o servidor. retorna: ok | used | invalid | revoked | free | offline | error
function KeyBind.serverCall(action, key)
local url = KEY_SERVER_URL .. (KEY_SERVER_URL:find("?", 1, true) and "&" or "?")
.. "action=" .. action
.. "\&k=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(key)
.. "\&u=" .. tostring(LP.UserId)
.. "\&n=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(LP.Name)
local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
if not ok then return "offline" end
local ok2, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
if not ok2 or type(data) \~= "table" then return "error" end
return tostring(data.status)
end

\-- tenta usar a key com ESTA conta. retorna true ou false, motivo
function KeyBind.claim(k)
if KEY_SERVER_URL \~= "" then
local st = KeyBind.serverCall("claim", k)
if st == "ok" then return true end
return false, st
end
local h = hashKey(k)
local good, why = checkKeyHash(h)
if not good then return false, why end
local owners = loadOwners()
local o = owners\[h]
if o == nil then owners\[h] = LP.UserId saveOwners(owners) return true end
if tonumber(o) == LP.UserId then return true end
return false, "used"
end

function KeyBind.savedKey()
if not (isfile and readfile) then return nil end
local ok, ex = pcall(isfile, keyFilePath())
if not ok or not ex then return nil end
local ok2, c = pcall(readfile, keyFilePath())
if not ok2 then return nil end
local k = normalizeKey(c)
return k:match(KEY_PATTERN) and k or nil
end

\-- so olhando o arquivo (sem internet): usado na aba Sistema
function KeyBind.localValid()
local k = KeyBind.savedKey()
if not k then return false end
if KEY_SERVER_URL \~= "" then return true end
local h = hashKey(k)
if not (checkKeyHash(h)) then return false end
local o = loadOwners()\[h]
return o == nil or tonumber(o) == LP.UserId
end

\-- no inicio: confere a key salva (com o servidor, se houver)
local function isKeyVerified()
local k = KeyBind.savedKey()
if not k then return false end
if KEY_SERVER_URL == "" then return KeyBind.localValid() end
local st = KeyBind.serverCall("check", k)
if st == "ok" then return true end
if st == "offline" or st == "error" then return true end   -- sem internet: nao tranca quem ja entrou
clearKeySaved()   -- usada por outra conta / revogada / invalida: volta para a tela de key
return false
end

local function getConfigPath(name) return CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/" .. name .. ".json" end

local function saveConfig(name, data)
if not writefile then return false, "writefile missing" end
ensureFolder()
local ok, enc = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(data) end)
if not ok then return false, "encode error" end
local ok2, err = pcall(writefile, getConfigPath(name), enc)
if not ok2 then return false, tostring(err) end
return true
end

local function loadConfig(name)
if not (readfile and isfile) then return nil end
if not isfile(getConfigPath(name)) then return nil end
local ok, content = pcall(readfile, getConfigPath(name))
if not ok then return nil end
local ok2, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(content) end)
if not ok2 then return nil end
return data
end

local function listConfigs()
if not (listfiles and isfolder) then return {} end
if not isfolder(CONFIG _FOLDER) then return {} end
local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, CONFIG_FOLDER)
if not ok then return {} end
local out = {}
for_, f in ipairs(files) do
local n = f:match("(\[^/\\]+)%.json$")
if n then table.insert(out, n) end
end
return out
end

local function deleteConfig(name)
if not (delfile and isfile) then return false end
if not isfile(getConfigPath(name)) then return false end
pcall(delfile, getConfigPath(name))
return true
end

\--// ============== TEXTO FLUIDO + SCRAMBLE ==============
local fluidList, fluidPaused = {}, false

local function fluidSeq(strong)
return ColorSequence.new({
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, C.fl1),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.30, C.fl2),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, strong and C.fl4 or C.fl3),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.70, C.fl2),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, C.fl1),
})
end

local function Fluid(label, speed, strong)
label.TextColor3 = C.white
local g = new("UIGradient", {Color = fluidSeq(strong), Parent = label})
table.insert(fluidList, {
	g = g, strong = strong, speed = speed or 1, phase = math.random() * 6,
	page = label:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame"),
})
return g
end

do
local acc = 0
RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
acc = acc + dt
if acc \< 1 / 30 or fluidPaused then return end
acc = 0
local t = os.clock()
for i = #fluidList, 1, -1 do
local f = fluidList\[i]
if not f.g.Parent then
table.remove(fluidList, i)
elseif not f.page or f.page.Visible then
local p = t \* f.speed + f.phase
f.g.Offset = Vector2.new(math.sin(p) _0.75, math.sin(p_ 0.6) \* 0.15)
f.g.Rotation = 20 _math.sin(p_ 0.8) + 10 _math.cos(p_ 1.7)
end
end
end)
end

local function Spin(g, obj, speed)
local con
con = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
if not obj.Parent then con:Disconnect() return end
g.Rotation = (g.Rotation + dt \* speed) % 360
end)
end

local chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789#$%&@\<>/\\"
local scrambling = {}
local function Scramble(label, final, duration)
duration = duration or 0.6
scrambling\[label] = (scrambling\[label] or 0) + 1
local id = scrambling\[label]
task.spawn(function()
local steps = math.max(8, math.floor(duration \* 40))
for i = 1, steps do
if scrambling\[label] \~= id or not label.Parent then return end
local reveal = math.floor(i / steps \* #final)
local out = final:sub(1, reveal)
for k = reveal + 1, #final do
if final:sub(k, k) == " " then out = out .. " "
else local r = math.random(1, #chars) out = out .. chars:sub(r, r) end
end
label.Text = out
task.wait(duration / steps)
end
if scrambling\[label] == id then label.Text = final end
end)
end

\--// ============== SISTEMA DE ABAS / COMPONENTES ==============
local tabs, tabCount = {}, 0
local UI_Refs = {}

local function switchTab(name)
for n, t in pairs(tabs) do
local a = (n == name)
t.page.Visible = a
tween(t.btn, 0.25, {BackgroundColor3 = a and C.active or C.item})
end
local t = tabs\[name]
if t then Scramble(t.lbl, name, 0.35) end
end

local function card(page, h, order, clickable)
local c = new(clickable and "TextButton" or "Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), BackgroundColor3 = C.item,
	BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = page})
if clickable then c.Text = "" c.AutoButtonColor = false end
corner(c, 10)
local s = stroke(c, C.accent, 1, 0.7)
return c, s
end

local function hover(c, s)
c.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(c, 0.2, {BackgroundColor3 = C.hover}) tween(s, 0.2, {Transparency = 0.1}) end)
c.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(c, 0.2, {BackgroundColor3 = C.item}) tween(s, 0.2, {Transparency = 0.7}) end)
end

local function userCard(parent, userId, display, name, line3, line4, c4, order)
local c = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 92), BackgroundColor3 = C.item, BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
	BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order or 0, Parent = parent})
corner(c, 12)
stroke(c, C.accent, 1.5, 0.3)
local hb = new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64),
	BackgroundColor3 = C.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = c})
corner(hb, 10)
stroke(hb, C.accent2, 2, 0)
local im = new("ImageLabel", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. tostring(userId) .. "&w=150&h=150", Parent = hb})
corner(im, 9)
local n = lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 10), Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 18), Font = GB, TextSize = 15, Text = tostring(display)})
Fluid(n, 1, true)
lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 30), Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 16), Font = GR, TextSize = 11, Text = "@" .. tostring(name), TextColor3 = C.dim})
lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 48), Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 16), Font = CODE, TextSize = 10, Text = line3, TextColor3 = C.accent2})
lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 66), Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 16), TextSize = 10, Text = line4, TextColor3 = c4 or C.success})
return c
end

local function AddTab(name)
tabCount = tabCount + 1
local btn = new("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundColor3 = C.item, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
	BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = tabCount, Parent = sidebar})
corner(btn, 8)
local bl = lbl(btn, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Font = GB, TextSize = 11, Text = name, TextXAlignment = CENTER})
Fluid(bl, 0.9)

local page = new("ScrollingFrame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
	ScrollBarThickness = 3, ScrollBarImageColor3 = C.accent, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
	AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Visible = false, Parent = pagesHolder})
new("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = page})
new("UIPadding", {PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8), Parent = page})

tabs\[name] = {btn = btn, page = page, lbl = bl}
btn.Activated:Connect(function() switchTab(name) end)

local n = 0
local function ord() n = n + 1 return n end
local T = {page = page}

function T:Order() return ord() end

function T:Section(text)
local l = lbl(page, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), Font = GBK, TextSize = 14, Text = text, LayoutOrder = ord()})
Fluid(l, 1.2, true)
return l
end

function T:Label(text)
return lbl(page, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = text,
		TextColor3 = C.dim, TextWrapped = true, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, LayoutOrder = ord()})
end

function T:Frame(h)
local c = card(page, h, ord())
return c
end

function T:List(pad)
local f = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = ord(), Parent = page})
new("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, pad or 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = f})
return f
end

function T:Button(text, desc, cb)
local hasDesc = desc and desc \~= ""
local h = hasDesc and 46 or 36
local c, s = card(page, h, ord(), true)
local t = lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, hasDesc and 6 or 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, hasDesc and 20 or h),
		Font = GB, TextSize = 13, Text = text})
Fluid(t, 0.8)
if hasDesc then
lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 26), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 14), Font = GR, TextSize = 10, Text = desc, TextColor3 = C.dim})
end
hover(c, s)
c.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Scramble(t, t.Text, 0.3) end)
c.Activated:Connect(function()
tween(c, 0.08, {Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, h - 2)})
task.delay(0.08, function() tween(c, 0.3, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
if cb then task.spawn(cb, c, t) end
end)
return c, t
end

function T:Toggle(id, text, desc, default, cb)
local on = default and true or false
local c, s = card(page, 46, ord(), true)
local t = lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 5), Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 20), Font = GB, TextSize = 13, Text = text})
Fluid(t, 0.8)
lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 26), Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 14), Font = GR, TextSize = 10, Text = desc or "", TextColor3 = C.dim})
local track = new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 20),
		BackgroundColor3 = on and C.accent or C.off, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = c})
corner(track, 10)
local knob = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), Position = on and UDim2.fromOffset(22, 2) or UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.white, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = track})
corner(knob, 8)
local function apply()
tween(track, 0.25, {BackgroundColor3 = on and C.accent or C.off})
tween(knob, 0.3, {Position = on and UDim2.fromOffset(22, 2) or UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
tween(s, 0.25, {Transparency = on and 0.1 or 0.7})
end
if on then s.Transparency = 0.1 end
hover(c, s)
c.Activated:Connect(function()
on = not on
apply()
Scramble(t, text, 0.25)
if cb then task.spawn(cb, on) end
end)
if id then
UI_Refs\[id] = {set = function(v) on = v and true or false apply() if cb then cb(on) end end, get = function() return on end}
end
return c
end

function T:Slider(id, text, default, min, max, step, cb)
local c = card(page, 62, ord())
local t = lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 18), Font = GB, TextSize = 13, Text = text})
Fluid(t, 0.8)
local vl = lbl(c, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 18),
		Font = CODE, TextSize = 13, Text = tostring(default), TextColor3 = C.accent2, TextXAlignment = RIGHT})
local function sb(txt, pos, anchor)
local b = new("TextButton", {Position = pos, AnchorPoint = anchor or Vector2.new(0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 22),
			BackgroundColor3 = C.bg, Text = txt, Font = GB, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = C.text, AutoButtonColor = false,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = c})
corner(b, 6)
return b
end
local minus = sb("-", UDim2.fromOffset(14, 34))
local plus = sb("+", UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 34), Vector2.new(1, 0))
local bar = new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 40), Size = UDim2.new(1, -104, 0, 10), BackgroundColor3 = C.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = c})
corner(bar, 5)
local fill = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale((default - min) / (max - min), 1), BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = bar})
corner(fill, 5)
new("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(C.accent, C.accent2), Parent = fill})
local hit = new("TextButton", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 32), Size = UDim2.new(1, -104, 0, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", Parent = c})
local val, drag = default, false
local function update(silent)
val = math.floor(val \* 1000 + 0.5) / 1000
vl.Text = tostring(val)
tween(fill, 0.1, {Size = UDim2.fromScale((val - min) / (max - min), 1)})
if cb and not silent then cb(val) end
end
local function hubVisible() return root.Visible and root.AbsoluteSize.X > 40 and bar.AbsoluteSize.X > 4 end
local function fromX(x)
if not hubVisible() then drag = false return end   -- hub fechado/minimizado: ignora qualquer toque
local rel = math.clamp((x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, bar.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
val = math.clamp(math.floor((min + rel _(max - min)) / step + 0.5)_ step, min, max)
update()
end
hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
drag = true
fromX(i.Position.X)
end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
if drag and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then fromX(i.Position.X) end
end)
\-- solta o slider SEMPRE que o dedo/mouse sobe (mesmo com o hub fechado)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then drag = false end
end)
minus.Activated:Connect(function() val = math.max(min, val - step) update() end)
plus.Activated:Connect(function() val = math.min(max, val + step) update() end)
if id then UI_Refs\[id] = {set = function(v) val = math.clamp(v, min, max) update() end, get = function() return val end} end
return c
end

function T:Dropdown(id, text, options, default, cb)
local c, s = card(page, 46, ord(), true)
local t = lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 5), Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 20), Font = GB, TextSize = 13, Text = text})
Fluid(t, 0.8)
lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 26), Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 14), Font = GR, TextSize = 10, Text = "Toque para alterar", TextColor3 = C.dim})
local vl = lbl(c, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 20),
		Font = CODE, TextSize = 12, Text = default, TextColor3 = C.accent2, TextXAlignment = RIGHT})
local idx = 1
for i, o in ipairs(options) do if o == default then idx = i break end end
hover(c, s)
c.Activated:Connect(function()
idx = idx % #options + 1
Scramble(vl, options\[idx], 0.25)
if cb then cb(options\[idx]) end
end)
if id then
UI_Refs\[id] = {set = function(v)
			for i, o in ipairs(options) do
				if o == v then idx = i vl.Text = o if cb then cb(o) end return end
			end
		end, get = function() return options[idx] end}
end
return c
end

function T:Color(id, text, default, cb)
local c = card(page, 68, ord())
local t = lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 20), Font = GB, TextSize = 13, Text = text})
Fluid(t, 0.8)
local pv = new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 24),
		BackgroundColor3 = default, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = c})
corner(pv, 6)
stroke(pv, C.accent2, 1.5, 0)
local holder = new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 38), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = c})
new("UIListLayout", {FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, Parent = holder})
local function applyColor(col) pv.BackgroundColor3 = col if cb then cb(col) end end
local presets = {Color3.fromRGB(255, 26, 26), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0), Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 136),
		Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255), Color3.fromRGB(150, 70, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)}
for i, col in ipairs(presets) do
local sw = new("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = holder})
corner(sw, 12)
sw\.Activated:Connect(function() applyColor(col) end)
end
if id then UI_Refs\[id] = {set = function(col) applyColor(col) end, get = function() return pv.BackgroundColor3 end} end
return c
end

function T:ScriptCard(sname, desc, code, img)
local c, s = card(page, 76, ord(), true)
new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -24), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, Parent = c})
local ib = new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, Parent = c})
corner(ib, 10)
stroke(ib, C.accent, 1, 0.4)
if img then
local im = new("ImageLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Image = img, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, Parent = ib})
corner(im, 8)
end
local t = lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(74, 16), Size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, 22), Font = GB, TextSize = 15, Text = sname})
Fluid(t, 0.8)
lbl(c, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(74, 40), Size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, 16), Font = GR, TextSize = 10, Text = desc, TextColor3 = C.dim})
local ex = new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 38),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.active, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, Parent = c})
corner(ex, 8)
stroke(ex, C.accent2, 1, 0.3)
local el = lbl(ex, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Font = GB, TextSize = 12, Text = "EXECUTAR", TextXAlignment = CENTER})
Fluid(el, 1.4, true)
hover(c, s)
local running = false
c.Activated:Connect(function()
if running then return end
if code == nil then
notify("Sem script", sname .. ": o script ainda nao foi adicionado.", "warn")
return
end
if code == "" then
local opened = openKeySite()
notify("Doritos", opened and "Abrindo site..." or "Link copiado! Cole no navegador.", opened and "success" or "warn")
return
end
running = true
el.Text = "..."
tween(ex, 0.2, {BackgroundColor3 = C.warn})
task.spawn(function()
local ok, err = executeScript(code)
task.wait(0.6)
el.Text = "EXECUTAR"
tween(ex, 0.2, {BackgroundColor3 = C.active})
if ok then notify("Sucesso", sname .. " executado.", "success")
else notify("Erro", tostring(err):sub(1, 70), "error") end
running = false
end)
end)
return c
end

return T
end

\--// ============== STRINGS DE SCRIPT ==============
local ESP _PRESET = \[==\[
local Players=game:GetService("Players") local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local LP=Players.LocalPlayer local drawings={}
local function add(p) if drawings\[p] then return end
local box=Drawing.new("Square") box.Thickness=1 box.Color=Color3.fromRGB(150,70,255) box.Filled=false
local name=Drawing.new("Text") name.Size=13 name.Center=true name.Outline=true name.Color=Color3.new(1,1,1)
local dist=Drawing.new("Text") dist.Size=12 dist.Center=true dist.Outline=true dist.Color=Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)
drawings\[p]={box=box,name=name,dist=dist}
end
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
for_,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if p\~=LP and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
add(p) local root=p.Character.HumanoidRootPart
local pos,on=workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
local d=drawings\[p]
if on then local dd=(root.Position-workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
local s=1700/dd d.box.Size=Vector2.new(&#x73;_&#x30;.55,s) d.box.Position=Vector2.new(pos.X-&#x73;_&#x30;.275,pos.Y-&#x73;_&#x30;.5)
d.box.Visible=true d.name.Text=p.Name d.name.Position=Vector2.new(pos.X,pos.Y-&#x73;_&#x30;.5-15) d.name.Visible=true
d.dist.Text=math.floor(dd).."m" d.dist.Position=Vector2.new(pos.X,pos.Y+s\*0.5+3) d.dist.Visible=true
else d.box.Visible=false d.name.Visible=false d.dist.Visible=false end
end
end
end)
]==]

	BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = CODE, PlaceholderText = "-- Cole teu codigo Lua aqui...",

\--// ============== GUBBYHUB: AUTO ULT (Dummy) ==============
do
local VIM = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
local ULT_KEY = Enum.KeyCode.G   -- ult no PC (troque se for outra tecla)
local AU = {on = false, useUlt = true, speed = 2, radius = 7, clickDelay = 0.05, target = nil, angle = 0, auto = true,
	lastScan = 0, mobile = UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled, ultPos = nil, ultBtn = nil, calib = nil}

tGubby:Section("AUTO ULT")
tGubby:Label("Ligue o toggle: voce gira em volta do Dummy, da M1 e usa a ult. Use DUMMY AUTO para focar o mais proximo ou escolha um na lista.")

\--// quadradinho verde/vermelho + nome do Dummy
local statusCard = tGubby:Frame(44)
local sq = new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
	BackgroundColor3 = C.danger, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = statusCard})
corner(sq, 4)
local statusLbl = lbl(statusCard, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 1, 0), Font = GB,
	TextSize = 12, Text = "Dummy: nao encontrado", TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd})
local function setDummyStatus(m)
sq.BackgroundColor3 = m and C.success or C.danger
statusLbl.Text = m and ("Dummy: " .. m.Name) or "Dummy: nao encontrado"
end

\--// procura os Dummies (NPCs) e ordena do mais perto para o mais longe
local function dummyList()
local myChar = LP.Character
local root = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local out = {}
for \_, h in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
if h:IsA("Humanoid") and h.Health > 0 then
local m = h.Parent
if m and m:IsA("Model") and m \~= myChar and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m)
and (m.Name:lower():find("dummy") or h.Name:lower():find("dummy")) then
local r = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if r then out\[#out + 1] = {m = m, d = root and (r.Position - root.Position).Magnitude or 0} end
end
end
end
table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.d \< b.d end)
return out
end
local function nearestDummy()
local l = dummyList()
return l\[1] and l\[1].m or nil
end

\--// ---------- ult e M1 ----------
local function nameMatches(n, words)
n = n:lower()
for \_, w in ipairs(words) do
if n == w or n:sub(1, #w) == w then return true end
end
return false
end
local function findGameButton(words)
local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
if not pg then return nil end
for \_, o in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
if (o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("ImageButton")) and o.Visible and nameMatches(o.Name, words) then return o end
end
return nil
end
local function fireButton(btn)
local fired = false
if getconnections then
for \_, sig in ipairs({btn.MouseButton1Down, btn.MouseButton1Click, btn.Activated, btn.MouseButton1Up}) do
pcall(function()
for \_, cn in ipairs(getconnections(sig)) do cn:Fire() fired = true end
end)
end
end
return fired
end
local function tapAt(x, y)
pcall(function()
VIM:SendTouchEvent(1, 0, x, y)
task.wait(0.03)
VIM:SendTouchEvent(1, 2, x, y)
end)
end
local function m1Click()   -- auto click (VirtualUser)
pcall(function()
VirtualUser:Button1Down(Vector2.new(0, 0), workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
task.wait(0.01)
VirtualUser:Button1Up(Vector2.new(0, 0), workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
end)
end
local function pressUlt()
if AU.mobile then
if AU.ultPos then tapAt(AU.ultPos.X, AU.ultPos.Y) return end
if not (AU.ultBtn and AU.ultBtn.Parent) then AU.ultBtn = findGameButton({"ult", "ultimate"}) end
local b = AU.ultBtn
if b and not fireButton(b) then
local p, s = b.AbsolutePosition, b.AbsoluteSize
tapAt(p.X + s.X / 2, p.Y + s.Y / 2 + GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y)
end
return
end
pcall(function()
VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, ULT_KEY, false, game)
task.wait(0.05)
VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, ULT_KEY, false, game)
end)
end

\--// calibrar o botao da ult no celular: toque no botao do jogo
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
if not AU.calib then return end
if i.UserInputType \~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and i.UserInputType \~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
local pos = Vector2.new(i.Position.X, i.Position.Y)
local ap, as = root.AbsolutePosition, root.AbsoluteSize
if root.Visible and as.X > 40 and pos.X >= ap.X and pos.X \<= ap.X + as.X and pos.Y >= ap.Y and pos.Y \<= ap.Y + as.Y then return end
AU.ultPos = pos
AU.calib = nil
notify("Calibrado", "Botao da ULT salvo!", "success")
end)

\--// ---------- loop principal ----------
local orbitConn
local function stopAutoUlt()
AU.on = false
if orbitConn then orbitConn:Disconnect() orbitConn = nil end
end
local function startAutoUlt()
stopAutoUlt()
AU.on = true
orbitConn = RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
if not AU.on then return end
local m = AU.target
if not m or not m.Parent then
if os.clock() - AU.lastScan > 1 then   -- procura de novo, no maximo 1x por segundo
AU.lastScan = os.clock()
AU.target = nearestDummy()
setDummyStatus(AU.target)
end
return
end
if AU.auto and os.clock() - AU.lastScan > 3 then   -- no modo AUTO continua no mais proximo
AU.lastScan = os.clock()
local n = nearestDummy()
if n and n \~= AU.target then AU.target = n setDummyStatus(n) m = n end
end
local mr = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local ch = LP.Character
local r = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not mr or not r then return end
AU.angle = AU.angle + dt \* AU.speed
local off = Vector3.new(math.cos(AU.angle) _AU.radius, 0, math.sin(AU.angle)_ AU.radius)
r.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mr.Position + off, mr.Position)
r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end)
task.spawn(function()
while AU.on and gui.Parent do
if AU.target then m1Click() end
task.wait(AU.clickDelay)
end
end)
task.spawn(function()
while AU.on and gui.Parent do
task.wait(1)
if AU.useUlt and AU.target then pressUlt() end
end
end)
end

\--// botao redondo (Rick Prime) no lado esquerdo: toque liga/desliga o Auto Ult, segure 0.4s para mover
local rickBtn = new("TextButton", {Name = "RickAutoUlt", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, 0),
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60), BackgroundColor3 = C.bg, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 900, Parent = gui})
corner(rickBtn, 30)
local rst = stroke(rickBtn, C.danger, 3, 0)
local rimg = new("ImageLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -8), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Image = thumb("102434660897566"), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ZIndex = 901, Parent = rickBtn})
corner(rimg, 26)
local function paintRick() tween(rst, 0.2, {Color = AU.on and C.success or C.danger}) end

do
local pressing, canDrag, cancelled, pStart, pOrig, token = false, false, false, nil, nil, 0
rickBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
token = token + 1
local my = token
pressing, canDrag, cancelled, pStart, pOrig = true, false, false, i.Position, rickBtn.Position
task.delay(0.4, function()
if token == my and pressing and not cancelled then
canDrag = true
tween(rst, 0.15, {Thickness = 6})
end
end)
end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
if pressing and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
local d = i.Position - pStart
if canDrag then
rickBtn.Position = UDim2.new(pOrig.X.Scale, pOrig.X.Offset + d.X, pOrig.Y.Scale, pOrig.Y.Offset + d.Y)
elseif math.abs(d.X) > 10 or math.abs(d.Y) > 10 then
cancelled = true
end
end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
if pressing and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
if not canDrag and not cancelled and UI_Refs.AutoUlt_On then UI_Refs.AutoUlt_On.set(not AU.on) end
if canDrag then tween(rst, 0.2, {Thickness = 3}) end
pressing, canDrag = false, false
end
end)
end

tGubby:Toggle("AutoUlt_On", "Auto Ult", "Gira no Dummy + M1 + ult", false, function(v)
if v then
AU.target = AU.target and AU.target.Parent and AU.target or nearestDummy()
setDummyStatus(AU.target)
if not AU.target then notify("Auto Ult", "Dummy nao encontrado. Va para o treino.", "warn") end
startAutoUlt()
else
stopAutoUlt()
notify("Auto Ult", "Desativado", "info")
end
paintRick()
end)

\--// ---------- ajustes ----------
tGubby:Section("AJUSTES")

tGubby:Slider("AutoUlt_Click", "Velocidade", 10, 1, 99, 1, function(v) AU.clickDelay = 0.5 / v end)
table.insert(Cleanup, stopAutoUlt)

\--// ---------- GOJO 0.2: teleporta para o Dummy a cada 0.2s ----------
local G2 = {on = false, delay = 0.2, token = 0}
tGubby:Section("GOJO 0.2")
tGubby:Toggle("Gojo02_On", "Gojo 0.2", "Teleporta para o Dummy a cada 0.2s", false, function(v)
G2.on = v

notify("Gojo 0.2", "Ativado - indo para o Dummy", "success")
task.spawn(function()
local m, lastScan = nil, 0
while G2.on and G2.token == my and gui.Parent do
\-- Dummy escolhido na lista (se houver); senao o mais proximo. Procura de novo so 1x por segundo.
if not AU.auto and AU.target and AU.target.Parent then

elseif not (m and m.Parent) or os.clock() - lastScan > 1 then
lastScan = os.clock()

local ch = LP.Character

end

end

end)

\--// ============== GUBBYHUB ==============
local State_G = {gojo = false, esp = false, speed = false, speedVal = 50}

tGubby:Section("PRINCIPAL")

\--// Gojo 0.2: teleporta para o Dummy mais proximo a cada 0.2s
local function nearestDummyG()
local ch = LP.Character
local myRoot = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
for \_, h in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
if h:IsA("Humanoid") and h.Health > 0 then
local m = h.Parent
if m and m:IsA("Model") and m \~= ch and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m)
and (m.Name:lower():find("dummy") or h.Name:lower():find("dummy")) then
local r = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if r then
local d = myRoot and (r.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude or 0
if d \< bestD then best, bestD = m, d end
end
end
end
end
return best
end
tGubby:Toggle(nil, "Gojo 0.2", "Teleporta para o Dummy a cada 0.2s", false, function(a)
State_G.gojo2 = a
if a then
notify("Gojo 0.2", "ATIVADO", "success")
task.spawn(function()
local dummy
while State_G.gojo2 and gui.Parent do
if not (dummy and dummy.Parent) then dummy = nearestDummyG() end   -- procura de novo so se sumiu
local ch = LP.Character
local r = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local mr = dummy and dummy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if r and mr then
r.CFrame = mr.CFrame \* CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end
task.wait(0.2)
end
end)
else
notify("Gojo 0.2", "DESATIVADO", "error")
end
end)

\--// ============== NAOYA HUB: ORBITAL (Jogadores com rosto) ==============
do
local orbitTarget, orbitRunning, orbitVoltas, orbitRadius = nil, false, 4, 8
local rows = {}

tNaoya:Section("NAOYA HUB - ORBITAL")
tNaoya:Label("Ligue ORBITAL, toque num jogador da lista para girar em volta dele. Toque de novo (ou no X) para parar.")

\--// indicador na tela com X para parar
local ind = new("Frame", {Name = "NaoyaIndicator", Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -56), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 36),
	BackgroundColor3 = C.active, BackgroundTransparency = 0.1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 900, Parent = gui})
corner(ind, 8)
stroke(ind, C.accent2, 2, 0)
local indLbl = lbl(ind, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 1, 0), Font = GB, TextSize = 12,
	Text = "Orbitando", TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 901})
local xBtn = new("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
	BackgroundColor3 = C.danger, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "X", Font = GB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.white,
	AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 902, Parent = ind})
corner(xBtn, 6)

local function paintRows()
for plr, r in pairs(rows) do
local on = (orbitTarget == plr)
r.stroke.Color = on and C.success or C.accent
r.stroke.Transparency = on and 0.1 or 0.7
end
end

local function stopOrbit()
orbitRunning = false
orbitTarget = nil
ind.Visible = false
paintRows()
end
xBtn.Activated:Connect(stopOrbit)
table.insert(Cleanup, stopOrbit)

local function startOrbit(plr)
orbitTarget = plr
indLbl.Text = "Orbitando: " .. plr.DisplayName
ind.Visible = true
paintRows()
if orbitRunning then return end
orbitRunning = true
task.spawn(function()
local angle = 0
while orbitRunning and orbitTarget and orbitTarget.Parent and gui.Parent do
local dt = RS.Heartbeat:Wait()
local myRoot = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local tChar = orbitTarget and orbitTarget.Character
local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if myRoot and tRoot then
angle = angle + orbitVoltas _dt_ math.pi \* 2
local off = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) _orbitRadius, 0, math.sin(angle)_ orbitRadius)
myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(tRoot.Position + off, tRoot.Position)
myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end
end
orbitRunning = false
orbitTarget = nil
ind.Visible = false
paintRows()
end)
end

local listHolder
tNaoya:Toggle("Naoya_Orbital", "ORBITAL", "Mostra a lista de jogadores para orbitar", false, function(v)
listHolder.Visible = v
if not v then stopOrbit() end
end)
tNaoya:Slider("Naoya_Radius", "Distancia", 8, 3, 30, 1, function(v) orbitRadius = v end)

\--// ============== ANUNCIOS E COMANDOS DO DONO (aba Sistema, so para o admin) ==============
\-- O dono escreve uma mensagem: ela aparece ACIMA do script de quem usa o hub (com o rosto do dono).
\-- Comandos: /Deletar Key id | /Kick id | /Chamar. Precisa do servidor (KEY_SERVER_URL) para chegar em todos.
do
local isAdmin = (LP.UserId == ADMIN_ID)
local PW_FILE = CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/.admin_pw"
local SEEN_FILE = CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/.last_msg"
local lastMsg = 0
if isfile and readfile then
pcall(function()
if isfile(SEEN_FILE) then lastMsg = tonumber(readfile(SEEN_FILE)) or 0 end
end)
end
local function saveSeen()
if writefile then ensureFolder() pcall(writefile, SEEN_FILE, tostring(lastMsg)) end
end

local function getJSON(params)
if KEY_SERVER_URL == "" then return nil end
local parts = {}
for k, v in pairs(params) do parts\[#parts + 1] = k .. "=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(tostring(v)) end
local url = KEY_SERVER_URL .. (KEY_SERVER_URL:find("?", 1, true) and "&" or "?") .. table.concat(parts, "&")
local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
if not ok then return nil end
local ok2, d = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
return (ok2 and type(d) == "table") and d or nil
end

\--// ---------- comandos recebidos (so os fixos abaixo; nunca executa codigo vindo do servidor) ----------
local function handleCmd(c)
local me = tostring(LP.UserId)
local target = tostring(c.target or "")
if target \~= me and target \~= "all" then return end
if c.type == "kick" and target == me then
notify("Removido", "O dono tirou voce do jogo.", "error")
task.wait(0.8)
pcall(function() LP:Kick("Voce foi removido pelo dono do GUBBYHUB.") end)
gui:Destroy()
elseif c.type == "chamar" then
showBanner({uid = c.uid, name = c.name, text = "O dono esta te chamando!"})
notify("Chamando!", "O dono do GUBBYHUB esta te chamando.", "warn")
elseif c.type == "revoked" and target == me then
notify("Key desativada", "O dono desativou a sua key.", "error")
clearKeySaved()
task.wait(1.5)
gui:Destroy()
end
end

if KEY _SERVER_URL \~= "" then
pcall(function() if getgenv then getgenv().GUBBYHUB_AVISO = true end end)   -- evita aviso duplicado se outro script tambem tiver o AVISO
task.spawn(function()
local since
while gui.Parent do
local d = getJSON({action = "poll", since = since or "", u = LP.UserId})
if d and d.status == "ok" then
local m = d.msg
if type(m) == "table" and (tonumber(m.id) or 0) > lastMsg and (tonumber(d.now) or 0) - (tonumber(m.t) or 0) \< 600000 then
lastMsg = tonumber(m.id)
saveSeen()
showBanner(m)
end
if since \~= nil then
for_, c in ipairs(d.cmds or {}) do handleCmd(c) end
end
since = tonumber(d.cid) or since or 0
end
task.wait(10)
end
end)
end

local function result(text, col)

local function sendMessage(text, pw)
if KEY_SERVER_URL == "" then
showBanner({uid = LP.UserId, name = LP.DisplayName, text = text})
result("Sem servidor: mostrei so para voce.", C.warn)
return
end
local d = getJSON({action = "say", pw = pw, t = text, u = LP.UserId, n = LP.DisplayName})
if not d then result("Sem conexao com o servidor.", C.danger) return end
if d.status == "denied" then result("Senha errada (ou ADMIN_SECRET nao foi trocada no servidor).", C.danger) return end
if d.status \~= "ok" then result("Nao deu certo: " .. tostring(d.status), C.danger) return end
lastMsg = tonumber(d.id) or lastMsg
saveSeen()
showBanner({uid = LP.UserId, name = LP.DisplayName, text = text})
msgBox.Text = ""
result("Mensagem enviada para todos!", C.success)
end

local function runCommand(text, pw)
if KEY_SERVER_URL == "" then result("Comandos precisam do servidor (KEY_SERVER_URL).", C.warn) return end
local cmd, rest = text:lower():match("^/(%S+)%s\*(.\*)$")
local params = {action = "cmd", pw = pw, u = LP.UserId, n = LP.DisplayName}
if cmd == "deletar" or cmd == "deletarkey" then
local id = (cmd == "deletar") and rest:match("^key%s+(%d+)$") or rest:match("^(%d+)$")
if not id then result("Use: /Deletar Key id", C.warn) return end
params.type, params.arg = "deletekey", id
elseif cmd == "kick" then
local id = rest:match("^(%d+)$")
if not id then result("Use: /Kick id", C.warn) return end
if id == tostring(LP.UserId) then result("Voce nao pode se kickar.", C.warn) return end
params.type, params.target = "kick", id
elseif cmd == "chamar" then
params.type, params.target = "chamar", rest:match("^(%d+)$") or "all"
else
result("Comando desconhecido. Use /Deletar Key id, /Kick id ou /Chamar.", C.warn)
return
end
local d = getJSON(params)
if not d then result("Sem conexao com o servidor.", C.danger) return end
if d.status == "denied" then result("Senha errada (ou ADMIN_SECRET nao foi trocada no servidor).", C.danger) return end
if d.status == "notfound" then result("Nenhuma key encontrada com esse id.", C.warn) return end
if d.status \~= "ok" then result("Nao deu certo: " .. tostring(d.status), C.danger) return end
if params.type == "deletekey" then result("Key desativada (" .. tostring(d.revoked) .. ").", C.success)
elseif params.type == "kick" then result("Kick enviado para " .. params.target .. ".", C.success)
else result("Chamada enviada.", C.success) end
end

sendBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
local text = msgBox.Text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
local pw = pwBox.Text

if writefile and pw \~= "" then ensureFolder() pcall(writefile, PW_FILE, pw) end
if text:sub(1, 1) == "/" then runCommand(text, pw) else sendMessage(text, pw) end
end)

do
local AMARELO = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0)
local tracked = {}   -- modelo -> {hl = Highlight, orig = {parte = {cor, material}}}

local function refreshCount()
local n = 0
for \_ in pairs(tracked) do n = n + 1 end
DummyS.count.Text = "Dummies encontrados: " .. n
end

local function looksLikeDummy(m)
local hum = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not hum then return false end
if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then return false end
local c = LP.Character
if c and (m == c or m:IsDescendantOf(c)) then return false end
if DummyS.all then return true end
if m.Name:lower():find("dummy") or hum.Name:lower():find("dummy") or hum.DisplayName:lower():find("dummy") then return true end
local anc = m.Parent
while anc and anc \~= workspace do   -- boneco dentro de pasta chamada "Dummies" etc.
if anc.Name:lower():find("dummy") then return true end
anc = anc.Parent
end
for \_, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do   -- texto "Dummy" acima da cabeca
if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Text:lower():find("dummy") then return true end
end
return false
end

local function applyDummy(m)
if tracked\[m] then return end
local rec = {orig = {}}
rec.hl = new("Highlight", {Name = "GubbyDummyHL", FillColor = AMARELO, OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 150),
		FillTransparency = 0.35, OutlineTransparency = 0, DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop, Adornee = m, Parent = m})
for \_, part in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name \~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
rec.orig\[part] = {part.Color, part.Material}
pcall(function() part.Color = AMARELO part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic end)
end
end
tracked\[m] = rec
refreshCount()
end

local function removeDummy(m)
local rec = tracked\[m]
if not rec then return end
tracked\[m] = nil
pcall(function() rec.hl:Destroy() end)
for part, o in pairs(rec.orig) do
if part.Parent then pcall(function() part.Color = o\[1] part.Material = o\[2] end) end
end
refreshCount()
end

local function scanAll()
local i = 0
for \_, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
i = i + 1
if i % 3000 == 0 then task.wait() end   -- nao trava o jogo em mapas grandes
if inst:IsA("Humanoid") then
local m = inst.Parent
if m and m:IsA("Model") and not tracked\[m] and looksLikeDummy(m) then applyDummy(m) end
end
end
end

local scanning = false
function DummyS.update()
if scanning then return end
scanning = true
if DummyS.on then
scanAll()
for m in pairs(tracked) do   -- tira os que nao se encaixam mais (ex.: desligou "Todos os NPCs")
if not looksLikeDummy(m) then removeDummy(m) end
end
else
for m in pairs(tracked) do removeDummy(m) end
end
scanning = false
end

\-- manutencao: refaz o destaque se o jogo remover/trocar o dummy
task.spawn(function()
while gui.Parent do
task.wait(3)
if DummyS.on then
for m, rec in pairs(tracked) do
if not m.Parent then tracked\[m] = nil
elseif not rec.hl.Parent then removeDummy(m) end
end
refreshCount()
DummyS.update()
end
end
end)

\-- modo arco-iris: o destaque troca de cor; ao desligar volta para amarelo
function DummyS.recolor()
if DummyS.rainbow then return end
for \_, rec in pairs(tracked) do
if rec.hl.Parent then rec.hl.FillColor = AMARELO end
end
end
task.spawn(function()
local hue = 0
while gui.Parent do
task.wait(0.05)
if DummyS.on and DummyS.rainbow then
hue = (hue + 2) % 360
local col = Color3.fromHSV(hue / 360, 1, 1)
for \_, rec in pairs(tracked) do
if rec.hl.Parent then rec.hl.FillColor = col end
end
end
end
end)

\-- dummy novo / que reaparece
track(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
if not DummyS.on or not inst:IsA("Humanoid") then return end
task.wait(0.3)
local m = inst.Parent
if m and m:IsA("Model") and not tracked\[m] and looksLikeDummy(m) then applyDummy(m) end
end))
table.insert(Cleanup, function()   -- devolve cor/material do Dummy
DummyS.on = false
for m in pairs(tracked) do removeDummy(m) end
end)
end

local bypassConn
local function resetBypass()
if bypassConn then bypassConn:Disconnect() bypassConn = nil end
local ch = LP.Character
local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
local r = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if r then
for \_, n in ipairs({"GubbyBypassVel", "GubbyBypassGyro"}) do
local o = r:FindFirstChild(n)
if o then o:Destroy() end
end
end
end

table.insert(Cleanup, resetBypass)   -- solta o personagem (PlatformStand/BodyVelocity) ao fechar
local function startBypass()
setStatus("Bypass Ativado", C.success)
local alvo = Vector3.new(372.105, 61.47, 394.779)
local et = 1
bypassConn = RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
local ch = LP.Character
local r = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not r or not hum or hum.Health \<= 0 then
setStatus("Clique em Teste Bypass!", C.warn)
UI_Refs.Bypass_On.set(false)
return
end
hum.PlatformStand = true
local v = r:FindFirstChild("GubbyBypassVel")
if not v then
v = new("BodyVelocity", {Name = "GubbyBypassVel", MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge),
				Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Parent = r})
end
local g = r:FindFirstChild("GubbyBypassGyro")
if not g then
g = new("BodyGyro", {Name = "GubbyBypassGyro", MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge), Parent = r})
end
local pos = r.Position
if et == 1 then
g.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos, Vector3.new(pos.X, 380, pos.Z))
local d = 380 - pos.Y
if math.abs(d) > 5 then v.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(d \* 30, -1000, 1000), 0) else et = 2 end
elseif et == 2 then
local vv = Vector3.new(alvo.X, 380, alvo.Z)
g.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos, vv)
if (vv - Vector3.new(pos.X, 380, pos.Z)).Magnitude > 15 then
v.Velocity = (vv - pos).Unit \* 1000
else
et = 3
end
else
g.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos, alvo)
local d = alvo.Y - pos.Y
if math.abs(d) > 5 then
v.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(d \* 30, -800, 800), 0)
else
setStatus("Sem Servico")
UI_Refs.Bypass_On.set(false)
end
end
end)
end

tExtras:Toggle("Bypass_On", "Bypass", "Voo anti-fling ate o ponto de destino", false, function(v)
if v then
if bypassConn then return end
startBypass()
else
resetBypass()
setStatus("Sem Servico")
end
end)

local function hudDrag(f)
local dragging, ds, sp
f.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging, ds, sp = true, i.Position, f.Position
i.Changed:Connect(function() if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end end)
end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
local d = i.Position - ds
f.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + d.X, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + d.Y)
end
end)
end
local function makeHud(yOff, text)
local f = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 32), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, yOff),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.panel, BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 50, Parent = gui})
corner(f, 8)
stroke(f, C.accent, 1.2, 0.2)
local l = lbl(f, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Font = GB, TextSize = 11, Text = text, TextColor3 = C.accent2,
		TextXAlignment = CENTER, ZIndex = 51})
hudDrag(f)
return f, l
end

\-- Arrastar (mouse + toque)
local function makeDraggable(handle, target)
local dragging, dragStart, startPos, dragInput
handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = true
dragStart = input.Position
startPos = target.Position
input.Changed:Connect(function()
if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
dragging = false
end
end)
end
end)
handle.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragInput = input
end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if dragging and input == dragInput then
local d = input.Position - dragStart
local goal = UDim2.new(
startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y
)
TweenService:Create(target, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Position = goal}):Play()
end
end)
end

end
return out
end

## -- ABA VOID RUN (JJS): voa e se joga no void do mapa

local voidTab = createTab("VOID RUN")

local voidStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
voidStatus.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 20)
voidStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
voidStatus.Text = "Status: desligado"
voidStatus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
voidStatus.TextSize = 12
voidStatus.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
voidStatus.TextColor3 = PURPLE_GLOW
voidStatus.LayoutOrder = 10
voidStatus.Parent = voidTab

local VOID_SPEED = 150
local voidToken = 0

local function setNoclip(char, state)
for \_, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = not state end
end
end

local VOID_FLY_TIME = 5

local function runVoid()
voidToken += 1
local my = voidToken
local char = lp.Character
local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not root or not hum then voidStatus.Text = "Status: sem personagem" return end

local look = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
flat = flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and flat.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector
local dir = (flat + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0)).Unit

setNoclip(char, true)

local elapsed = 0
while voidToken == my and root.Parent and hum.Health > 0 and elapsed \< VOID_FLY_TIME do
local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
elapsed += dt
root.CFrame = root.CFrame + dir _(VOID_SPEED_ dt)
root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
voidStatus.Text = string.format("Status: voando... void em %.1fs", math.max(0, VOID_FLY_TIME - elapsed))
end

if voidToken == my and root.Parent and hum.Health > 0 then
voidStatus.Text = "Status: se jogando no void!"
local killY = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 10
while voidToken == my and root.Parent and hum.Health > 0 and root.Position.Y > killY do
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -250, 0)
end
end

if char and char.Parent then setNoclip(char, false) end
if voidToken == my then voidStatus.Text = "Status: concluido" end
end

addToggle(voidTab, "VOID RUN", function(on)
if on then
task.spawn(runVoid)
else
voidToken += 1
local c = lp.Character
if c then setNoclip(c, false) end
voidStatus.Text = "Status: desligado"
end
end)

\--// ============== VISUALS ==============
local ESPConfig = {
	ESP_Enabled = false, ESP_TeamCheck = true, ESP_VisibleCheck = false, ESP_TeamBasedColor = false,
	ESP_Outline = true, ESP_SelfESP = false, ESP_RenderDistance = 1000,
	Box_Enabled = true, Box_Fill = false, Box_Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 75),
	Name_Enabled = true, Name_Type = "Name", Name_Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	Chams_Enabled = false, Chams_Filled = true, Chams_Color = Color3.fromRGB(138, 43, 226),
	Tracer_Enabled = false, Tracer_Origin = "Bottom", Tracer_Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 100),
	Distance_Enabled = false, Distance_Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200),
	HeadDot_Enabled = false, HeadDot_Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
	HealthBar_Enabled = false,
}
local function VT(id, t, d) tVisuals:Toggle(id, t, d, ESPConfig\[id], function(v) ESPConfig\[id] = v end) end
local function VC(id, t) tVisuals:Color(id, t, ESPConfig\[id], function(c) ESPConfig\[id] = c end) end

tVisuals:Section("ESP MASTER")
VT("ESP_Enabled", "ESP Enabled", "Liga/desliga todo o ESP")
VT("ESP_TeamCheck", "Team Check", "Ignorar mesma equipe")
VT("ESP_VisibleCheck", "Visible Check", "Apenas visiveis")
VT("ESP_TeamBasedColor", "Team Based Color", "Cor por equipe")
VT("ESP_Outline", "Outline", "Contorno ESP")
VT("ESP_SelfESP", "Self ESP", "ESP no proprio jogador")
tVisuals:Slider("ESP_RenderDistance", "Distancia de Renderizacao", 1000, 50, 5000, 50, function(v) ESPConfig.ESP_RenderDistance = v end)
tVisuals:Section("BOX")
VT("Box_Enabled", "Box Enabled", "ESP de caixa")
VT("Box_Fill", "Box Fill", "Preencher caixa")
VC("Box_Color", "Box Color")
tVisuals:Section("NOME")
VT("Name_Enabled", "Name Enabled", "ESP de nome")
tVisuals:Dropdown("Name_Type", "Name Type", {"Name", "DisplayName", "Both"}, "Name", function(v) ESPConfig.Name_Type = v end)
VC("Name_Color", "Name Color")
tVisuals:Section("CHAMS")
VT("Chams_Enabled", "Chams Enabled", "Highlight")
VT("Chams_Filled", "Chams Filled", "Preenchimento")
VC("Chams_Color", "Chams Color")
tVisuals:Section("TRACER")
VT("Tracer_Enabled", "Tracer Enabled", "Linha de tracer")
tVisuals:Dropdown("Tracer_Origin", "Tracer Origin", {"Top", "Bottom", "Center", "Mouse"}, "Bottom", function(v) ESPConfig.Tracer_Origin = v end)
VC("Tracer_Color", "Tracer Color")
tVisuals:Section("INDICADORES")
VT("Distance_Enabled", "Distance", "Mostrar distancia")
VT("HeadDot_Enabled", "Head Dot", "Ponto na cabeca")
VT("HealthBar_Enabled", "Health Bar", "Barra de vida")

do
local ESP_Objects = {}
local function CreateDrawing(class, props)
if not DrawingLib then return nil end
local d = DrawingLib.new(class)
for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do pcall(function() d\[k] = v end) end
return d
end

local function GetBoundingBox(char)
local minX, minY, maxX, maxY = math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
for \_, part in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name \~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
local p, s = part.Position, part.Size
local corners = {
			Vector3.new(p.X - s.X / 2, p.Y + s.Y / 2, p.Z - s.Z / 2), Vector3.new(p.X + s.X / 2, p.Y + s.Y / 2, p.Z + s.Z / 2),
			Vector3.new(p.X - s.X / 2, p.Y - s.Y / 2, p.Z - s.Z / 2), Vector3.new(p.X + s.X / 2, p.Y - s.Y / 2, p.Z + s.Z / 2),
		}
for \_, c in pairs(corners) do
local sp, on = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(c)
if on then
minX = math.min(minX, sp.X) minY = math.min(minY, sp.Y)
maxX = math.max(maxX, sp.X) maxY = math.max(maxY, sp.Y)
end
end
end
end
if minX == math.huge then return nil end
return {x = minX, y = minY, width = maxX - minX, height = maxY - minY, cx = (minX + maxX) / 2, cy = (minY + maxY) / 2}
end

local function ClearESP(plr)
local ch = plr.Character
local hl = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("ESP_Highlight")
if hl then hl:Destroy() end
local esp = ESP_Objects\[plr]
if not esp then return end
for \_, obj in pairs(esp) do
if obj then
if typeof(obj) == "Instance" then pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
elseif obj.Remove then pcall(function() obj:Remove() end) end
end
end
ESP_Objects\[plr] = nil
end

local function UpdateESP(plr)
if not DrawingLib then return end
if plr == LP and not ESPConfig.ESP_SelfESP then return end
if ESPConfig.ESP_TeamCheck and plr \~= LP and plr.Team == LP.Team then ClearESP(plr) return end
local char = plr.Character
if not char then ClearESP(plr) return end
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local rootP = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not hum or not rootP or hum.Health \<= 0 then ClearESP(plr) return end
local distance = (rootP.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
if distance > ESPConfig.ESP_RenderDistance then ClearESP(plr) return end

if not ESP_Objects\[plr] then ESP_Objects\[plr] = {} end
local esp = ESP_Objects\[plr]
local b = GetBoundingBox(char)
if not b then ClearESP(plr) return end

if ESPConfig.Box_Enabled then
if not esp.box then
esp.box = CreateDrawing("Square", {Thickness = 2, Transparency = 1, Visible = false, Filled = false})
esp.boxFill = CreateDrawing("Square", {Filled = true, Transparency = 0.5, Visible = false})
end
if esp.box then
esp.box.Size = Vector2.new(b.width, b.height) esp.box.Position = Vector2.new(b.x, b.y)
esp.box.Color = ESPConfig.Box_Color esp.box.Visible = true
end
if esp.boxFill then
if ESPConfig.Box_Fill then
esp.boxFill.Size = Vector2.new(b.width, b.height) esp.boxFill.Position = Vector2.new(b.x, b.y)
esp.boxFill.Color = ESPConfig.Box_Color esp.boxFill.Visible = true
else esp.boxFill.Visible = false end
end
else
if esp.box then esp.box.Visible = false end
if esp.boxFill then esp.boxFill.Visible = false end
end

if ESPConfig.Name_Enabled then
if not esp.name then esp.name = CreateDrawing("Text", {Size = 14, Center = true, Outline = true, Transparency = 1, Visible = false}) end
if esp.name then
local text = plr.Name
if ESPConfig.Name_Type == "DisplayName" then text = plr.DisplayName
elseif ESPConfig.Name_Type == "Both" then text = plr.Name .. " (" .. plr.DisplayName .. ")" end
esp.name.Text = text
esp.name.Position = Vector2.new(b.cx, b.y - 20)
esp.name.Color = ESPConfig.Name_Color
esp.name.Outline = ESPConfig.ESP_Outline
esp.name.Visible = true
end
elseif esp.name then esp.name.Visible = false end

if ESPConfig.Distance_Enabled then
if not esp.distance then esp.distance = CreateDrawing("Text", {Size = 12, Center = true, Outline = true, Transparency = 1, Visible = false}) end
if esp.distance then
esp.distance.Text = string.format("\[%d studs]", math.floor(distance))
esp.distance.Position = Vector2.new(b.cx, b.y + b.height + 5)
esp.distance.Color = ESPConfig.Distance_Color
esp.distance.Visible = true
end
elseif esp.distance then esp.distance.Visible = false end

if ESPConfig.Tracer_Enabled then
if not esp.tracer then esp.tracer = CreateDrawing("Line", {Thickness = 1, Transparency = 1, Visible = false}) end
if esp.tracer then
local vs, o = Camera.ViewportSize, ESPConfig.Tracer_Origin
local ox, oy
if o == "Top" then ox, oy = vs.X / 2, 0
elseif o == "Bottom" then ox, oy = vs.X / 2, vs.Y
elseif o == "Center" then ox, oy = vs.X / 2, vs.Y / 2
else local m = UIS:GetMouseLocation() ox, oy = m.X, m.Y end
esp.tracer.From = Vector2.new(ox, oy)
esp.tracer.To = Vector2.new(b.cx, b.cy)
esp.tracer.Color = ESPConfig.Tracer_Color
esp.tracer.Visible = true
end
elseif esp.tracer then esp.tracer.Visible = false end

if ESPConfig.HealthBar_Enabled then
local hp = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
if not esp.healthBar then
esp.healthBarBg = CreateDrawing("Square", {Filled = true, Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30), Transparency = 0.8, Visible = false})
esp.healthBar = CreateDrawing("Square", {Filled = true, Transparency = 1, Visible = false})
end
if esp.healthBar then
local bh = b.height \* hp
if esp.healthBarBg then
esp.healthBarBg.Size = Vector2.new(4, b.height) esp.healthBarBg.Position = Vector2.new(b.x - 8, b.y) esp.healthBarBg.Visible = true
end
esp.healthBar.Size = Vector2.new(4, bh)
esp.healthBar.Position = Vector2.new(b.x - 8, b.y + (b.height - bh))
esp.healthBar.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 _(1 - hp), 255_ hp, 0)
esp.healthBar.Visible = true
end
else
if esp.healthBar then esp.healthBar.Visible = false end
if esp.healthBarBg then esp.healthBarBg.Visible = false end
end

if ESPConfig.HeadDot_Enabled then
if not esp.headDot then esp.headDot = CreateDrawing("Circle", {Filled = true, Transparency = 1, Visible = false}) end
local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
if head and esp.headDot then
local sp, on = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
if on then
esp.headDot.Position = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
esp.headDot.Radius = 5
esp.headDot.Color = ESPConfig.HeadDot_Color
esp.headDot.Visible = true
end
end
elseif esp.headDot then esp.headDot.Visible = false end

if ESPConfig.Chams_Enabled then
local hl = char:FindFirstChild("ESP_Highlight")
if not hl then hl = Instance.new("Highlight") hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight" hl.Parent = char end
hl.FillColor = ESPConfig.Chams_Color
hl.OutlineColor = ESPConfig.Chams_Color
hl.FillTransparency = ESPConfig.Chams_Filled and 0.5 or 1
hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
else
local hl = char:FindFirstChild("ESP_Highlight")
if hl then hl:Destroy() end
end
end

local espOn = false
RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
if ESPConfig.ESP_Enabled then
espOn = true
for \_, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do pcall(UpdateESP, p) end
elseif espOn then
espOn = false
for \_, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do ClearESP(p) end
end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) ClearESP(p) end)
table.insert(Cleanup, function()
ESPConfig.ESP_Enabled = false
for \_, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do ClearESP(p) end
end)
end

\--// ============== TEMAS ==============
local ThemeAPI = {}
do
local PAL _KEYS = {"bg", "panel", "item", "active", "accent", "accent2", "dim", "text", "hover", "off", "grad1", "fl1", "fl2", "fl3", "fl4"}
local DEFAULT_PAL = {}
for_, k in ipairs(PAL_KEYS) do DEFAULT_PAL\[k] = C\[k] end
local THEME_FILE = CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/.theme"

local function makePal(h)
local hsv = Color3.fromHSV
return {
		bg = hsv(h, 0.69, 0.10), panel = hsv(h, 0.68, 0.17), item = hsv(h, 0.68, 0.27), active = hsv(h, 0.76, 0.63),
		accent = hsv(h, 0.73, 1), accent2 = hsv(h, 0.49, 1), dim = hsv(h, 0.28, 0.77), text = hsv(h, 0.06, 1),
		hover = hsv(h, 0.62, 0.41), off = hsv(h, 0.50, 0.39), grad1 = hsv(h, 0.77, 0.31),
		fl1 = hsv(h, 0.65, 1), fl2 = hsv(h, 0.41, 1), fl3 = hsv(h, 0.13, 1), fl4 = hsv(h, 0.04, 1),
	}
end

local THEMES = {
	{name = "GUBBYHUB",   sub = "Padrao roxo",     img = IMG_BTN,                       pal = DEFAULT_PAL},
	{name = "RICK PRIME", sub = "Rick and Morty",  img = thumb("102434660897566"), pal = makePal(0.07)},
	{name = "RICK C-137", sub = "Rick and Morty",  img = thumb("107545868372538"), pal = makePal(0.33)},
	{name = "RICK MORRY", sub = "Rick and Morty",  img = thumb("71099820385271"),  pal = makePal(0.14)},
	{name = "GOJO",       sub = "Jujutsu Kaisen",  img = thumb("128945632487494"), pal = makePal(0.58)},
	{name = "ITADORI",    sub = "Jujutsu Kaisen",  img = thumb("131076537252100"), pal = makePal(0.95)},
	{name = "SUKUNA",     sub = "Jujutsu Kaisen",  img = thumb("125369431368374"), pal = makePal(0.00)},
}

task.spawn(function()
local list = {}
for \_, th in ipairs(THEMES) do list\[#list + 1] = th.img end
pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(list) end)
end)

\-- botao de abrir/fechar e wallpaper de cada tema (padrao = os originais; os outros usam a imagem do tema)
for \_, th in ipairs(THEMES) do
th.id = tostring(th.img):match("id=(%d+)") or tostring(th.img):match("rbxassetid://(%d+)") or ""
if th.name == "GUBBYHUB" then
th.btn, th.wall, th.wallT = IMG_BTN, IMG_HOME_BG, 0.9
else
th.btn, th.wall, th.wallT = th.img, th.img, 0.6
end

\--// imagens personalizadas por ID (valem por cima do tema): custom.btn = botao, custom.wall = wallpaper
local custom, customBoxes = {}, {}
local currentTh = THEMES\[1]
local CUSTOM_FILE = CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/.theme_custom"

local function applyImages(th)
currentTh = th
local wp = main:FindFirstChild("Wallpaper")
if wp then
if custom.wall then
wp.Image = thumb(custom.wall)
wp.ImageTransparency = 0.6
else
wp.Image = th.wall
wp.ImageTransparency = th.wallT
end
end

local fi = fb and fb:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel")
if fi then fi.Image = custom.btn and thumb(custom.btn) or th.btn end
end

local function saveCustom()
if not writefile then return end
ensureFolder()
pcall(function() writefile(CUSTOM_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(custom)) end)
end

local function loadCustom()
if not (isfile and readfile) then return end
local ok, ex = pcall(isfile, CUSTOM_FILE)
if not (ok and ex) then return end
local ok2, c = pcall(readfile, CUSTOM_FILE)
if not ok2 then return end
local ok3, d = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(c) end)
if not (ok3 and type(d) == "table") then return end
for \_, k in ipairs({"btn", "wall"}) do
local v = d\[k] and tostring(d\[k]):gsub("%D", "") or ""
custom\[k] = (#v >= 5) and v or nil
end
for k, b in pairs(customBoxes) do b.Text = custom\[k] or "" end
end

local current = {}
for \_, k in ipairs(PAL_KEYS) do current\[k] = C\[k] end

local function near(a, b) return math.abs(a.R - b.R) + math.abs(a.G - b.G) + math.abs(a.B - b.B) \< 0.006 end

\-- troca as cores em TODOS os elementos ja criados (e nos que forem criados depois, pois C muda)
local function applyPalette(pal)
local old = {}
for \_, k in ipairs(PAL_KEYS) do old\[k] = current\[k] end
for \_, k in ipairs(PAL_KEYS) do C\[k] = pal\[k] current\[k] = pal\[k] end
local function map(c)
for \_, k in ipairs(PAL_KEYS) do if near(c, old\[k]) then return C\[k] end end
return c
end
local props = {"BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3", "ImageColor3", "ScrollBarImageColor3", "PlaceholderColor3"}
for \_, holder in ipairs({gui, toastGui}) do
for \_, inst in ipairs(holder:GetDescendants()) do
if inst:IsA("UIStroke") then
local nv = map(inst.Color)
if nv \~= inst.Color then inst.Color = nv end
elseif inst:IsA("UIGradient") then
local list, changed = {}, false
for i, kp in ipairs(inst.Color.Keypoints) do
local nc = map(kp.Value)
if nc \~= kp.Value then changed = true end
list\[i] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, nc)
end
if changed then inst.Color = ColorSequence.new(list) end
elseif inst:IsA("GuiObject") then
for \_, pr in ipairs(props) do
local ok, v = pcall(function() return inst\[pr] end)
if ok and typeof(v) == "Color3" then
local nv = map(v)
if nv \~= v then inst\[pr] = nv end
end
end
end
end
end
for \_, f in ipairs(fluidList) do
if f.g.Parent then f.g.Color = fluidSeq(f.strong) end
end
end

function ThemeAPI.apply(name, silent)
for \_, th in ipairs(THEMES) do
if th.name == name then
applyPalette(th.pal)
applyImages(th)   -- wallpaper + botao flutuante (respeita os IDs personalizados)
for n, b in pairs(badges) do b.Text = (n == name) and "ATIVO" or "" end
if writefile then ensureFolder() pcall(writefile, THEME_FILE, name) end
if not silent then notify("Tema", name .. " aplicado!", "success") end
return true
end
end
return false
end

function ThemeAPI.loadSaved()
loadCustom()
local name = "GUBBYHUB"
if isfile and readfile then
local ok, ex = pcall(isfile, THEME_FILE)
if ok and ex then
local ok2, n = pcall(readfile, THEME_FILE)
if ok2 then name = (tostring(n):gsub("%s+$", "")) end
end
end
if not ThemeAPI.apply(name, true) then ThemeAPI.apply("GUBBYHUB", true) end
end
end

local function collectConfig()

return true
