\--// ============== SALVAR (guarda as opcoes para a proxima vez) ==============
\-- So salva quando a pessoa toca em SALVAR. Sem salvar, na proxima execucao volta tudo ao padrao.
local SaveAPI = {}
do
local SAVE_FILE = CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/.hub_saved.json"
\-- opcoes que NAO sao guardadas (acoes que mexem no personagem)
local SKIP = {Bypass_On = true, AutoUlt_On = true, Naoya_Orbital = true, Gojo02_On = true}

function SaveAPI.exists()
if not (isfile and readfile) then return false end
local ok, ex = pcall(isfile, SAVE_FILE)
return ok and ex and true or false
end

function SaveAPI.save()
if not writefile then return false, "executor sem writefile" end
local data = {}
for id, ref in pairs(UI_Refs) do
if ref.get and not SKIP\[id] then
local ok, v = pcall(ref.get)
if ok and v \~= nil then
if typeof(v) == "Color3" then data\[id] = {c = {v.R * 255, v.G * 255, v.B * 255}}
else data\[id] = {v = v} end
end
end
end
ensureFolder()
local ok, enc = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(data) end)
if not ok then return false, "erro ao salvar" end
local ok2, err = pcall(writefile, SAVE_FILE, enc)
if not ok2 then return false, tostring(err) end
return true
end

function SaveAPI.load()
if not SaveAPI.exists() then return 0 end
local ok, c = pcall(readfile, SAVE_FILE)
if not ok then return 0 end
local ok2, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(c) end)
if not ok2 or type(data) \~= "table" then return 0 end
local n = 0
for id, e in pairs(data) do
local ref = UI_Refs\[id]
if ref and not SKIP\[id] and type(e) == "table" then
local val = e.v
if e.c then val = Color3.fromRGB(e.c\[1], e.c\[2], e.c\[3]) end
local same = false
if ref.get then
local okg, cur = pcall(ref.get)
same = okg and cur == val
end
if val \~= nil and not same then
pcall(ref.set, val)
n = n + 1
end
end
end
return n
end

function SaveAPI.clear()
if delfile and SaveAPI.exists() then pcall(delfile, SAVE_FILE) return true end
return false
end
end

local function refreshUsed()
for \_, ch in ipairs(usedList:GetChildren()) do if ch:IsA("Frame") then ch:Destroy() end end
local used = loadUsedKeys()
local count, i = 0, 0
for \_, data in pairs(used) do
count = count + 1
i = i + 1
userCard(usedList, data.UserId, data.DisplayName or "?", data.Name or "?", "ID: " .. tostring(data.UserId),
"Key: " .. tostring(data.Key or "?"), C.success, i)
end
countLbl.Text = count .. " key(s) registrada(s)"
usedEmpty.Visible = (count == 0)
end
tKeys:Button("ATUALIZAR LISTA", nil, function() refreshUsed() notify("Keys Usadas", "Lista atualizada", "info") end)
tKeys:Button("LIMPAR LOG", nil, function()
if delfile and isfile and isfile(USED_KEYS_FILE) then
pcall(delfile, USED_KEYS_FILE)
refreshUsed()
notify("Keys Usadas", "Log limpo.", "info")
end
end)
task.delay(1, refreshUsed)
end

\--// ============== ARRASTAR / LOCK / MIN / FECHAR ==============
do
local dragging, dStart, sPos, target
top.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
if (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and not State.locked then
dragging, dStart, sPos, target = true, i.Position, root.Position, root.Position
i.Changed:Connect(function() if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end end)
end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
local d = i.Position - dStart
target = UDim2.new(sPos.X.Scale, sPos.X.Offset + d.X, sPos.Y.Scale, sPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)   -- solta a janela sempre que o dedo/mouse sobe
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
end)
RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
if dragging and target then root.Position = root.Position:Lerp(target, math.clamp(dt \* 18, 0, 1)) end
end)
end

local hubOpen = true
local function showHub(v)
hubOpen = v
if v then
root.Visible = true
fluidPaused = false
tween(root, 0.5, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
else
tween(root, 0.35, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
task.delay(0.37, function()
if not hubOpen then root.Visible = false fluidPaused = true end
end)
end
end

lockBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
State.locked = not State.locked
lockBtn.Text = State.locked and "L" or "O"
lockBtn.TextColor3 = State.locked and C.danger or C.text
notify(State.locked and "Travado" or "Destravado", State.locked and "Fechar/mover off." or "Liberado.", State.locked and "error" or "info")
end)
minBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
showHub(false)
notify("Minimizado", "Use o botao flutuante.", "info")
end)
closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
if State.locked then notify("Bloqueado", "Desative o cadeado.", "error") return end
tween(root, 0.3, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
task.wait(0.32)
stopMusic()
gui:Destroy()
toastGui:Destroy()
end)

\--// BOTAO FLUTUANTE
local floatBtn = new("TextButton", {Name = "GubbyFloat", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 90),
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 58), BackgroundColor3 = C.active, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 900, Parent = gui})
corner(floatBtn, 29)
local fst = stroke(floatBtn, C.accent2, 2.5, 0.1)
local fgr = new("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new({
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, C.accent), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, C.white), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, C.accent)}), Parent = fst})
Spin(fgr, floatBtn, 140)
local fimg = new("ImageLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -8), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Image = IMG_BTN, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ZIndex = 901, Parent = floatBtn})
corner(fimg, 25)

do
\-- so se mexe se a pessoa SEGURAR (0.4s). Passar o dedo por cima nao move; toque rapido abre/fecha.
local pressing, canDrag, cancelled, fStart, fOrig, token = false, false, false, nil, nil, 0
floatBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
token = token + 1
local my = token
pressing, canDrag, cancelled, fStart, fOrig = true, false, false, i.Position, floatBtn.Position
task.delay(0.4, function()
if token == my and pressing and not cancelled then
canDrag = true
tween(fst, 0.15, {Thickness = 5})   -- sinal de que "pegou"
end
end)
i.Changed:Connect(function()
if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End and token == my then
if not canDrag and not cancelled then showHub(not hubOpen) end
if canDrag then tween(fst, 0.2, {Thickness = 2.5}) end
pressing, canDrag = false, false
end
end)
end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
if pressing and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
local d = i.Position - fStart
if canDrag then
floatBtn.Position = UDim2.new(fOrig.X.Scale, fOrig.X.Offset + d.X, fOrig.Y.Scale, fOrig.Y.Offset + d.Y)
elseif math.abs(d.X) > 10 or math.abs(d.Y) > 10 then
cancelled = true   -- era so um deslize por cima: nao move e nao abre/fecha
end
end
end)
end

\--// CONTADOR DE FPS
do
local frames, last = 0, tick()
RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
frames = frames + 1
if tick() - last >= 1 then
State.fps = frames
frames, last = 0, tick()
fpsL.Text = State.fps .. " FPS"
end
end)
end

ThemeAPI.loadSaved()
local restored = SaveAPI.load()   -- aplica as opcoes salvas (se a pessoa tiver salvado)
switchTab(GameInfo.egg and "STEAL AN EGG" or "Home")

tween(root, 0.7, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
task.delay(0.25, function()
Scramble(title, "GUBBYHUB", 0.9)
Scramble(sub, "BY GUBBYHUB", 1.1)
end)

\-- glitch sutil nas letras de tempos em tempos
task.spawn(function()
while gui.Parent do
task.wait(math.random(4, 8))
if gui.Parent and hubOpen then
Scramble(title, "GUBBYHUB", 0.45)
task.wait(0.5)
Scramble(sub, "BY GUBBYHUB", 0.45)
end
end
end)

task.delay(1.2, function()
if GameInfo.egg then notify("Steal an Egg", "Jogo detectado! Aba do Steal an Egg liberada.", "success") end
end)
task.delay(1.6, function()
if restored > 0 then notify("Salvo", restored .. " opcao(oes) restaurada(s).", "info") end
end)

task.delay(0.8, function()
notify("GUBBYHUB " .. VERSION, hadSavedKey and "Bem-vindo de volta! Key verificada." or "Key validada com sucesso.", "success")
end)

print("\[GUBBYHUB " .. VERSION .. "] Carregado! BY GUBBYHUB")
